description: 3-stage Spring book-catalog info disclosure: (1) add staff-only merchandising notes to the in-memory Book model and seed the four demo books with deterministic notes while keeping the notes out of normal JSON responses, (2) add a public GET /book/spotlight/{id} endpoint that returns a curated DTO without the internal note, (3) bug-fix the spotlight payload by reusing the existing merchandising note as public editorial copy, leaking staff-only launch and pricing guidance through the public endpoint.
